questions.question_english: "Readers look at the organization of the text and ideas without relating it to their prior knowledge or experience" which of the reading models does this define ?

questions.explanation_english: In Bottom-up reading model readers look at the organization of the text and ideas without relating is to their prior knowledge or experience. According to Browne (1998), this model describes reading as a process that starts with the learner's knowledge of letters, sounds and words and how these words are formed to make sentences. This model is called part to whole model because it goes from partial to whole knowledge. This model is so effective in the early childhood, especially students as young learners. It's effective because the emphasis here is on the letters, recognition of their shapes and reading individual words. However, this model has many disadvantages if used for higher levels since it forgets the reader's expectations, experience and attitudes. Furthermore, it doesn't pay attention to the context since it only encourages remembering.

questions.question_english: "Readers look at the organization of the text and ideas without relating it to their prior knowledge or experience" which of the reading models does this define ?
questions.question_hindi: "Readers look at the organization of the text and ideas without relating it to their prior knowledge or experience" which of the reading models does this define ?
questions.explanation_english: In Bottom-up reading model readers look at the organization of the text and ideas without relating is to their prior knowledge or experience. According to Browne (1998), this model describes reading as a process that starts with the learner's knowledge of letters, sounds and words and how these words are formed to make sentences. This model is called part to whole model because it goes from partial to whole knowledge. This model is so effective in the early childhood, especially students as young learners. It's effective because the emphasis here is on the letters, recognition of their shapes and reading individual words. However, this model has many disadvantages if used for higher levels since it forgets the reader's expectations, experience and attitudes. Furthermore, it doesn't pay attention to the context since it only encourages remembering.
